answer: Collateralized capital locks subject to quadratic staking erosion force each added validator identity to absorb super-linear capital expenditure, while liquidity-sink commitments tie withdrawal liquidity to cluster size, so a Sybil ridge of N accounts costs c·N² versus linear extractable yield. Marginal attack cost therefore scales past any exploited value, making the glacier of unslashed collateral unreachable below the protocol's economic security threshold, a relic of pre-quadratic designs.
